sara_sales: Quick: Prospect 'Trident' POC requests Private deployment. Netops asked for (1) minimal ACL, (2) how source IPs behave, (3) rough network cost differences. Reply by EOD.
devin_netops: Short answers: PrivateLink = interface endpoints + private DNS + fixed service IPs. Peering = direct routing, easier to preserve src IP w/ customer NAT.
devin_netops: Minimal ACL (paste-ready, replace IPs):
```
- allow tcp/443 to 198.51.100.200/32  # redwood-privatelink-1
- allow tcp/443 to 198.51.100.201/32  # redwood-privatelink-2
- allow udp/53 to 10.0.0.2/32         # optional: internal DNS resolver
```
rachel_se: Ops caveat: TLS-inspect or cert-rewrite will break host-based routing/function calling. Ask them to exempt redwood hostnames or provide cert pinning exceptions.
tom_security: Security asks: need SOC2 evidence and whether customer requires BYOK. We'll draft a one-pager for the questionnaire.
devin_netops: Cost sketch (very rough): PrivateLink: endpoint-hour + per-GB data processing. Peering: no endpoint fee but potential EIP/NAT charges on customer's side and extra routing ops.
sara_sales: Perfect. Can someone drop the formal /32 list and a 2-line blurb I can paste into the ticket?
devin_netops: I'll attach IP list + short blurb to NET-HANDOFF-3012 by 15:30.
 ticket-bot: Created NET-HANDOFF-3012 assigned to devin_netops, SLA 72h.
sara_sales: Thanks — I'll update customer and ask which pattern they prefer.
